name: navigator
description: HTTP platform for executing declarative browser navigation workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @navigator/core && npm run build -w @navigator/cdp && npm run build -w @navigator/agent && npm run build -w @navigator/sdk
scripts.test: npm run build -w @navigator/core && npm run test -w @navigator/core && npm run test -w @navigator/agent && npm run test -w @navigator/sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @navigator/core && npm run typecheck -w @navigator/cdp && npm run typecheck -w @navigator/agent && npm run typecheck -w @navigator/sdk
